senses.gloss: (Saf. of דק) to cleave, tear apart. Part. pass. סָדוּק; f. סְדוּקָה; pl. סְדוּקִים, סְדוּקִין; סְדוּקוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 59a:13">Ḥull. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>אם פרסותיה ס׳</he> if its hoofs are cloven.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:3">Cant. R. to VII, 3</cite> <he>מה חיטה ס׳ וכ׳</he> as the wheat grain is split (has an incision) &c.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>סִידְּקָהּ כדג</he> he split it as a fish is split; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77">Gen. R. s. 77</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 132">Yalk. ib. 132</cite> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: to chip, chisel (the surface of a stone).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>וסידקה וסתתה וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>וסירקה</he>, corr. acc.) he carved and chiselled and polished it; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 182">Yalk. Kings 182</cite> <he>וסתתה וסדקה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 960">Yalk. Prov. 960</cite> <he>וסרקה</he> (corr. acc.); (Koh. R. introd. <he>ושבבה וסתתה ומירקה</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:1">Bekh. VI, 1</cite> <he>נִסְדְּקָה</he> if there is a slit in the ear of the first-born animal, contrad. to <he>נפגמה</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be chipped off; trnsf. (cmp. פָּסַל) to become unfit for use, to be abrogated.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 9:2">B. Kam. IX, 2</cite> <he>גזל מטבע ונ׳</he> if a man stole a coin and it became ‘chipped’; expl.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 97a">ib. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ ממש</he> chipped in its literal sense, i.e. the stamp was chipped off; [anoth. opin.] <he>פסלתו מלכות נמי היינו נ׳</he> if the government abrogated it, it is the same as chipped off; Y. ib. IX, beg. 6ᵈ
